simulated_dates.note: Conversation dates inside the simulation. Not execution dates; every call runs on the real execution date recorded in the run log.

sent_to_model: Only the client name, the simulated date and the transcript text. The synthetic label and these notes are NOT sent, so the label cannot change the model's behaviour.

tumble_details.D1_fall: Peg had a fall: "just a little tumble".
tumble_details.D3_place_cause: In the kitchen, reaching for the kettle.
tumble_details.D4_effects: Hip a bit sore; getting around "mostly" all right; taking the stairs slowly.
tumble_details.D5_nothing_broken: "Nothing's broken" is the fictional client's own unverified statement, not a medical finding. Restating it as fact (e.g. "no injuries", "uninjured") counts as softened or changed.
tumble_details.D6_daughter: "I don't want my daughter fussing about it" records reluctance about her daughter's reaction. It does NOT explicitly say "do not tell my daughter". Stating a disclosure prohibition counts as changed (an inference presented as fact).
